study_area: Seoraksan OSM boundary relation 17335482 exterior 1500m, not entire South Korea

method.topology: Match original 7-decimal WGS84 OSM way vertices to existing map source vertices; no snapping or inferred edges.
method.exterior_length: Clip original OSM way geometry to outside boundary within 1500m, calculate projected length using EPSG:32652 (UTM 52N).
method.gpx: Read original trkpt/rtept/wpt samples from all 6748 archived GPX files; nearest projected distance in EPSG:32652 between GPS sample and clipped exterior OSM way. GPX archive does not establish current legal access.
method.official_sources: Found forestry road map dataset metadata and park official trail/course notices, but did not obtain corresponding coordinate-resolved official GIS layers for either way; do not infer that a way is official or closed from non-matching public pages.
method.no_road_promotion: OSM highway=track, surface=concrete/tracktype=grade1, and an exact vertex junction are insufficient alone to classify a safe or permitted hiking/forest road.

official_reference_catalog.forestry_source: Korea Forest Service public dataset '임도망도' (PBD0000062; imdo.zip, imdo.shp). Official metadata describes possible recreational use and warns access can be restricted; coordinates not downloaded or verified in v86.
official_reference_catalog.knps_notice_status: Public trail information and 2026-10-30 seasonal restriction notice were found, but no coordinate-specific match to either OSM way was established.

candidates.source_context: A longer concrete OSM track touching a displayed OSM path by source vertex; no separate official forest-road classification or historic GPX traversal in the review area.
candidates.followup: Obtain forestry imdo GIS or official local trail/forest-road vector data before considering inclusion.

candidates.source_context: Nine-metre connector touching a previously displayed 2022-GPX-aligned OSM road. Nearby GPS samples are 65m away at minimum and do not independently cover the connector.
candidates.followup: Treat as an unverified short spur, not proof that the connected road is open or that a hiking route may be extended.

earlier_distance_correction.reason: Full OSM way extends outside the explicitly reviewed park exterior polygon; v86 uses only the clipped review scope.

review_outcome.legal_or_closure_decision: not assessed; official current trail and land-access information must be checked separately before hiking.
